obligation_candidates.canon_label: Historical Run Mode: all tabs clearly show the focused historical run_id; page displays a persistent banner/chip that the user is viewing historical data; controls that only make sense for the active …
exact_tokens: Historical Run Mode: all tabs clearly show the focused historical run_id; page displays a persistent banner/chip that the user is viewing historical data; controls that only make sense for the active run are disabled or removed
Historical-safe actions: inspect graph, inspect evidence, inspect ledger, export, view lineage, open related Source Control / GitHub / Docker context in historical mode
Actions disabled in historical mode: pause / resume / cancel active execution, live retry / remediation commands, approval/recovery actions that require current runtime state
